title: Platform compatibility: OData
description: OData readiness of scripts in scope. Claris publishes no per-step OData data - the step base is borrowed from the Server column (OData runs scripts server-side; stated per finding), plus catalog-derivable OData rules: script naming and Commit Records/Requests at the end of data-changing scripts.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: OData executes scripts as server-side scripts with additional naming and commit conventions; there is no per-step OData compatibility source, so the Server base is borrowed and marked as such.
rule.remediation: Fix server-incompatible steps, rename scripts to OData-safe names, and end data-changing scripts with Commit Records/Requests.

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: OData readiness findings (borrowed Server base + naming + commit rules)
